correctness.rationale: Explicit geodesics establish a total-visible set of size 2r. Unique same-side geodesics through x or y bound any spine-containing mutual set, and the only r=2 equality candidates are explicitly blocked. Therefore the internal vertices are the unique mutual maximum; since they are total-visible, the same value and unique maximizer hold for outer, dual, and total variants. Exhaustive direct verification for r=2..7 agrees.
